content.short: Tombala is a Web3 next-generation decentralized lottery platform.
content.description: Tombala is a Web3 decentralized lottery platform that connects with the Metaverse. It removes security restrictions, regional draws, and lengthy payments by enabling fully decentralized operations with transparency and privacy for players around the globe. Tombala NFT holders gain a stake in the platform and participate in the growing global lottery market. The NFT collection comprises 125 cards across five series, minted as ERC-1155 tokens, and each NFT provides investors a share in the Metaverse's largest lottery platform and lifelong passive income.
